description: Agent Datasets: submit a dataset’s stated quality claims with its own sample and profile: optionally the dataset with its id, name, version and the rows it states; the claims of the highest share of empty values for any field, the highest share of duplicate records, the highest share of invalid values and the label accuracy, with the quality wording, read for absolutes such as no missing values, fully deduplicated or 100% accurate; each field with its name, type (string, integer, number, boolean, date or category), whether it is required, its allowed values and its range; the labels with the label field, the label set and how many labels a review checked and agreed with; the profile with its row count, duplicate rows and each field’s empty and invalid counts; and a sample of records, each with its id, its values as written (a value left out reads as an empty cell) and its label. The signed report gives every field with its empty and invalid shares in the sample and the profile, the measures with the highest empty, duplicate and invalid shares beside the shares claimed, the labels with those outside the set, identical records labeled differently and the accuracy the review measured, and counts them, and names a deficient dataset: a field empty more often than claimed, a required field left empty, duplicates or invalid values above the claim, label accuracy below the claim, identical records labeled differently and absolute wording the data contradicts; then labels outside the set, fields the declaration leaves out and a row count that differs from the profile, with the fix for each and what would change the verdict. No sample or profile, no claimed figure, an untyped field and an accuracy claim no review backs leave the quality unverified. This reads one dataset’s claims against its own data: one JSON sample checked field by field is wever_data-evidence-check, an evaluation set against what an agent must handle is wever_evaluation-dataset-check and a claim against offered evidence is wever_claim-evidence-check. Verdict dataset_quality_deficient, dataset_quality_partial, dataset_quality_unverified or dataset_quality_sound. POST /api/dataset-quality-check. Reads the dataset records supplied in the call and returns a signed report with the verdict, the evidence read, the findings with their fixes, and what would change the verdict; the records stay in the report, with no network request, fetch, message, payment or external write. Agent Datasets reads a dataset’s own records and checks what is claimed about it: its quality claims against its own sample and profile, its current schema against the documented or prior one, its license against the intended use, its synthetic-data disclosure against its provenance, its freshness against its update log, its lineage against its source records, its privacy claims against its contents and handling, and its coverage against the population it is said to represent. Beside it, wever_data-evidence-check inspects one JSON sample field by field and wever_evaluation-dataset-check reads an evaluation set against what an agent must handle, while a dataset check reads a claim made about a dataset against the dataset’s own records; wever_license-evidence-check names the license family a text matches, while the license check reads the terms against one intended use; and wever_privacy-evidence-check reads privacy claims against a policy document, while the privacy check reads the dataset’s contents and handling records. Paid URL: 0.10 USDC per call on Base via x402 exact, with the shared 10 signed-wallet free calls per rolling 30 days. Bind X-Wever-Wallet-Proof to the exact JSON arguments and the tool route. Returns a report with an Ed25519 signed receipt. Contract: /api/agent-datasets-contract. Human page: https://weverlabs.com/agent-datasets/.

max_duplicate_percent.description: Highest share of duplicate records claimed.

max_invalid_percent.description: Highest share of invalid values claimed for any field.

max_missing_percent.description: Highest share of empty values claimed for any field.

text.description: Quality wording, read for absolutes such as no missing values, fully deduplicated or 100% accurate.

rows.description: Rows the dataset states it holds.

label.description: Optional name recorded in the report.
The record’s label, when the label sits outside its values.

value.description: As written; leave it out for an empty cell.
